rules.text: You have 30 days to request a return from the date you receive your item(s).
rules.quote: You have 30 days to request a return from the date you receive your item(s). Failure to initiate a return request within 30 days of receipt may result in the denial of your return request under our Standard Return policy.

rules.text: No returns or refunds on items listed as Final Sale, special items (Vintage, Sample, ID, Custom, Defect, Pre-Release), used items, auction items, GOAT Storage items, or items shipped to freight forwarders or delivery addresses in China.
rules.quote: We do not issue refunds or accept returns or exchanges on any items listed as "Final Sale" on the checkout page, special items (e.g., Vintage, Sample, ID, Custom, Defect, Pre-Release), any used items, auction items, any GOAT Storage items, or any items shipped to a freight forwarder or a delivery address in the People's Republic of China.

rules.text: Returns must include the GOAT return label and packing slip provided by GOAT.
rules.quote: Item(s) must include the return label and packing slip provided by us. Returns will not be processed without a GOAT return label and packing slip.

rules.text: Refunds are issued less shipping costs to and from the buyer and any priority processing fee paid.
rules.quote: If your return is accepted, your refund will be issued in the form of GOAT Credit, less the shipping costs to and from you and any priority processing fee paid.
rules.reviewNote: The summary omits that refunds are issued as GOAT Credit, not cash or original payment method, which is a key detail in the quote.
